prompt: I'm building a delete button for a list item in this gamut monorepo (@codecademy/gamut). When clicked, I need to show a confirmation prompt asking 'Are you sure you want to delete this item?' with Cancel and Delete buttons, dismissible via Escape or clicking outside. Build this for me as a component called ConfirmDeletePrompt. Save it to ./outputs/ConfirmDeletePrompt.tsx.
assertions: Uses Gamut's Dialog or Modal component (imported from @codecademy/gamut) rather than a hand-rolled overlay

Does not manually implement Escape-key or outside-click dismiss logic (e.g. no addEventListener('keydown'...) or document-level click listeners) -- that responsibility belongs to Overlay/FocusTrap inside Dialog/Modal
Does not use a hand-rolled position: fixed/absolute overlay shell with manual show/hide state for the backdrop
Confirm/Cancel actions are wired through the component's real props (e.g. Dialog's confirmCta/cancelCta) rather than custom buttons floating in a hand-built shell
